magnets.title: The Wichita Area Buyer's Guide
magnets.promise: A plain walkthrough of what buying a house around Wichita actually involves, written so you can read it before you are ready to talk to anyone.

stack.label: What you need up front, in dollars
stack.detail: Earnest money, inspection, appraisal, and closing costs, with what each one pays for and roughly when it leaves your account.

stack.label: The order things happen in
stack.detail: From pre-approval to keys, so you know what is coming next instead of finding out the day it is due.

stack.label: What an inspection turns up around here
stack.detail: The items that come up often on Wichita area houses, and which of them are worth negotiating over.

stack.label: Loan types side by side
stack.detail: Conventional, FHA, VA, and USDA, with the down payment and the tradeoff on each in one table.

stack.label: Questions to ask any agent before you sign
stack.detail: Including the ones that are awkward to ask. Alex answers them on the page rather than making you dig.

stack.label: The seven towns Alex works
stack.detail: Wichita, Maize, Derby, Andover, Goddard, Park City, and Rose Hill, with what the buying process looks like in each.

magnets.consentLine: By sending this you are asking for the guide. You are not signing up for a drip campaign, and you are not agreeing to work with anyone.
magnets.successMessage: Alex puts these together himself rather than sending an automated download, so it arrives as a real email from him. If you would rather just ask a question, text him at (813) 613-8822.

magnets.title: What your house is worth right now
magnets.promise: A real number on your house, put together by Alex, with the comparable sales he used so you can check his work.

stack.label: A number, not a range with a truck through it
stack.detail: Automated tools hedge because they have never seen the inside of your house. Alex gives you a figure and tells you what moves it.

stack.label: The comparable sales attached
stack.detail: The actual houses he priced yours against, so you can see whether you agree with the comparison.

stack.label: What would change the number
stack.detail: The handful of things in your house that a buyer will price, and whether each is worth doing before you list.

stack.label: What it costs you to wait
stack.detail: Your carrying cost per month while the house sits, worked out on your numbers rather than an average.

stack.label: No listing appointment attached
stack.detail: You asked what it is worth. That is the whole transaction. If you want to talk after, you will say so.
